examples.text: The apples cost 50 cents each.

glosses: Individually; separately; used in a sentence with a plural subject to indicate that the action or state described by the verb applies to all members of the described group individually, rather than collectively to the entire group.

examples.text: In one embodiment, there is an additional charge when ordering products as an “each” compared to the unit cost of the item when ordered by the case.
